github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: CRITICAL REQUIREMENT: Always start the commit message with the active git branch name followed by space and (<type>):
<message> must be concise, single line, summary in English.

antigravity.commitMessage.instructions: Always format commit message as: <branch> (<type>): <message> where <message> is short, single line, in English. Example: feature_v4.0.0 (chore): add settings.
antigravity.commitMessagePrompt: Always format commit message strictly as: <branch> (<type>): <message>. Example: feature_v4.0.0 (chore): update documentation.
